chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah al-Himyari narrated to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn 'Amirah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:

We heard him (Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)) say: If a full year passes and one does not visit the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), Allah will reduce his lifespan by one year. And if I told you that one of you dies thirty years before his appointed time, I would be telling the truth, and this is because you neglect visiting al-Husayn (peace be upon him). So do not neglect his visitation, for Allah will prolong your lives and increase your sustenance. And if you neglect his visitation, Allah will reduce your lives and your sustenance. So compete with one another in visiting him and do not neglect that, for al-Husayn will testify on your behalf regarding that before Allah, His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family), Fatimah (peace be upon her), and the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of visiting the grave of Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh highlights the metaphysical link between the physical act of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s grave and divine blessings, framing it as a means to extend lifespan (umr) and increase sustenance (rizq). The hadith uniquely positions Imam al-Husayn as an active witness alongside Allah, the Prophet, Fatimah, and Ali, underscoring the Ahl al-Bayt’s ongoing spiritual authority. This encourages believers to compete in ziyarah, viewing it not merely as remembrance but as a tangible source of divine favor and intercession.
